constraint_decided_it: P14.1 in the role of qualifies the participation of the actor the P14 statement attaches to (FOL: P14(x,y,z) => [P14(x,y) AND E55(z)]). B hangs P14.1 'senior weaver' on the Group's P14, which asserts the collective acted in a role the source gives to one guiding individual -- the same overclaim B rejects for the three named women. A keeps the senior weaver out of the Group's role slot and stays inside every declared domain/range (P108 E12->E24 with the basket as E22; P14 E7->E39 with E12 subset E11 subset E7 and E74 subset E39; P11 E5->E39 on the session).
better_modelling: E12 Production P108 has produced -> the basket (E22, which is the E24 subclass P108's range requires; 'E19' alone would be outside it), P14 carried out by -> an E74 Group for the household's women (E74 scope note: gatherings that act collectively through 'creating some common artifact'; 'Married couples and other concepts of family are regarded as particular examples'). The senior weaver is a distinct E21 Person -- E21 comprises 'real persons who live or are assumed to have lived' and imposes no naming requirement, so a person known only by definite description is a legitimate instance -- carried by a second P14 with P14.1 in the role of 'senior weaver' (E55). Model the communal session as an E7 Activity, P9 consists of the E12 Production (E7 subset E5 subset E4, so P9's E4->E4 holds), and attach the three named women to the session with P11 had participant, which 'does not imply any causal relationship'. The consultation's identification itself belongs in an E13 Attribute Assignment (P140/P141/P177), the CRM's construct for registering someone else's opinion while the maintaining team stays neutral -- neither answer reached it.
reasoning: Both pick the same core, E12 Production P14 carried out by an E74 Group, and both are right to refuse P14 to the three named E21 Persons, since P14 'implies causal or legal responsibility' and the consultation could not confirm any of them handled this basket. A is the better modelling: it adds P108 to the object, separates session participation (P11) from the production attribution, and its two t1477 quotations are verbatim -- but it claims the SIG discussion 'concludes the current model still expresses this with plain P14', and t1477 is a two-message thread that concludes nothing (Rob Sanderson's open question plus one non-committal reply), while Issue 542 is marked Done only because 'the group has resolved to discontinue work on CRMsoc... hence this issue is closed' (Bern, April 2025). That is a conclusion attributed to a source that does not contain it, so A is unsupported even though its modelling stands. B's citations check out (t1477 verbatim; Issue 2's accepted proposal does say individuals go to E21 and groups to E74, and B's notes flag the paraphrase), but B commits a modelling error A does not, and rests it on a false premise that an E21 Person must be named.
